description: Core permissions for the k7s main window (B75 audit). All Kubernetes access goes through our own Rust commands, so the frontend only needs what it provably uses: invoke/listen/getVersion (core:app/event), the window (getCurrentWindow + setTheme), plus the plugin surfaces (shell open, file dialogs, window-state, updater, process relaunch). core:path/image/resources/menu/tray are deliberately not granted.
